purpose: Defines how the consult skill is used for dialogue-based revision, where decisions are applied on the spot, including console and HTML display, list format, current-topic format, recording, and execution.
summary: Input is the conversation context; consult extracts topics from it
Display roles split between console (overview) and HTML (details); the HTML script does not exist yet
Console list format with columns for number, topic, status, result, and pending issue
Current-topic format with decision point, gist, recommendation, and clickable path:line locations
Rules for markers: arrow for current row, updated and new suffixes, no importance column
Other console rules: tables for parallel items, no fine chapters, at most one extra table or code block
Presentation state is held in conversation context
Topics decided by the user may be executed immediately; final list is the result
tasks: Answering reports or questions through consult
Deciding when to execute decided topics
Writing or revising consult display rules
title: 対話による修正の手順
